description:
Call any PacketFabric API endpoint by operation_id.

    Reads run immediately. Writes (create/modify/delete — may create billable services)
    are only possible when the server was started with PF_ALLOW_WRITES=true, and return a
    dry-run preview unless confirm=true. Always show the user the preview and get explicit
    approval before re-calling with confirm=true.

confirm.description: Required true to actually execute a write. Without it, writes return a preview only.
confirm.title: Confirm

fields.description: Only return these keys from each item (dot paths allowed, e.g. 'interfaces'). Omit for all.
fields.title: Fields

params.description: Path and query parameters by name, e.g. {'port_circuit_id': 'PF-AP-LAX1-1234', 'since': '1 day ago'}. Lists are sent as repeated query params.
params.title: Params

name: pf_call_endpoint
